unrestricted_coprime_family.description: For q=p+1, old interval [0,s), and s consecutive q-blocks, the mod-p multiplicities are the triangular convolution of two length-s intervals.
unrestricted_coprime_family.consequence_P1: Taking s about sqrt(p) makes projection/N about 2/s, so no bound with a fixed C^b in place of 2^b can hold for arbitrary coprime moduli.
unrestricted_coprime_family.consequence_P2_P3: Taking s proportional to p makes the interval discrepancy and energy excess exceed the proposed fixed-C scales; the loss is coherent block phase, not a bad numerical constant.

interpretation: Each listed inequality is an exact strict violation. The examples kill only the stated phase-blind candidates. They do not refute a theorem that explicitly pays for window block count and q mod p coherence, nor the open aligned maximum-gap theorem.
